dataset: All-surface 316L sour-corrosion literature reference mapping, not material-specific prediction
sourceArticle: Shah et al. 2022, Corrosion Behavior of AISI 316L Stainless Steel in a Highly Sour Environment
surfaceMapping: Every triangle of all ten CAD bodies, including internal and external chamber surfaces, end plates and hubs, is exposed to the same hypothetical sour electrolyte. A 0.70 mm/y 316L uniform-corrosion reference is applied everywhere. Previously highlighted lower-interior chamber patches retain hypothetical interpolation up to 2.4 mm/y as a sensitivity illustration ONLY, not simulated pit location.
notes: All five alloys use identical AISI 316L-based reference exposure. Uniform 0.70 mm/y is measured literature benchmark for 316L; peak 2.4 mm/y is a separate reported pitting benchmark used as illustrative hotspots (location NOT predicted). 30+ day numbers are linear what-if, not predictions. No H2S electrochemical solver, material-specific rates, pressure-driven fluid flow or corrosion-structural FEA.
coverageDescription: All internal/external surfaces of all 6 chamber bodies, both end plates, and both hubs receive full sour-service surface reference. Hidden camera components are still evaluated.
